title: Rescue from Wrath
definition: Rescue from Wrath is God's deliverance of believers from deserved judgment through the saving work of Christ.
summary: Rescue from Wrath teaches that Christ delivers believers from the righteous judgment their sins deserve.
christFocus: Jesus Christ bore judgment at the cross and rescues believers from condemnation.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Rescue from wrath means Christ saves His people from the righteous judgment their sins deserve. Scripture speaks honestly about wrath because God's justice is real and evil is not harmless.

This doctrine is not meant to create panic or manipulation. It shows the seriousness of sin and the greatness of mercy: believers are delivered by Christ, not left to face judgment alone.

Jesus rescues from the wrath to come by bearing judgment at the cross. The same Savior who warns also provides refuge in Himself.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because modern people often want salvation from pain but not from judgment. Rescue from wrath keeps the Gospel honest about what Christ saves us from and why His mercy is so astonishing.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Run to Christ as your refuge, not to denial, excuses, or comparison with others. Speak of judgment with tears and truth, always pointing people to the Savior who rescues sinners.
